environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; soft, stylized petals with tactile, waxy textures; rounded forms avoiding sharp edges; vibrant but natural color accents against the dark forest floor.

visual_logic.composition: A close-up 'hero' shot of primitive flowering plants emerging from a dark, damp log. The background is a soft-focus vista of a stagnant, misty lake forest.
visual_logic.ground: Saturated forest floor with layers of dark, decaying organic matter and visible laminated paper-shale fragments.
visual_logic.lighting: Dappled cinematic sunlight piercing through the canopy, creating a spotlight effect on the delicate flowers.
